services.name: Orange Beach Parasail
services.desc: About the Trip >Since 2004, the Southern Rose has been offering Gulf Coast parasailing adventures along Orange Beach in Alabama. Whether you are an experienced veteran or this is your first outing, there has never been a better time to parasail. Alabama is full of beautiful scenery, and parasailing allows you to see it all from heights of up to 800 feet. >We have the largest fleet of parasail boats in the area, and all of our vessels and crew are U.S. Coast Guard approved. Photo packages of your trip are available for $40, and include 40-60 high quality images. If you would like to learn more about our parasailing services, or if you are ready to book your trip, contact us
